notes: Model number on device/box is SBWD960A (base) with an SBWD960B variant noted in the datasheet as adding "Gigabit Ethernet to support wider range of modern networking switches" — however the base spec table already lists Ethernet as 10/100/1000-BASE-T RJ-45 LAN, so grade eth-1g applies to the documented interface; the 960B enhancement likely refers to guaranteed full Gigabit switch compatibility rather than a different port. No HDMI or DisplayPort version is stated in the datasheet, so no HDMI grade was set (base spec supports up to 1080p30 via H.264, consistent with HDMI 1.4-class bandwidth, but this is not explicitly confirmed). USB port is explicitly "USB 2.0 Host Type-A" so grade usb-2.0 is confirmed. VGA input is a pass-through (loops to nothing else documented as a separate VGA output pass path) - treated as a standard bidirectional-capable analog video input per datasheet wording "VGA Input (Pass-through)". Power adapter is external (5VDC, 2A barrel jack), device itself uses a DC barrel jack input, not an integrated AC inlet. Desktop puck-shaped unit (6.61 x 6.61 x 1.36 in) - not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.
